CustomField.description: How many calendar months before an Opportunity's Grant End Date the renewal-alert Task should be created. 6 = create it six months ahead. Read at runtime by the Create Grant Renewal Alert Task scheduled flow, so changing this record changes the lead time with no flow edit. Blank falls back to 6 in the flow.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Calendar months before the Grant End Date to create the renewal-alert Task. Default 6.
CustomField.label: Months Before End
